title: People look: NPC archetypes, cloth, skin, hair, animation

items.name: 41 original NPC archetypes (ages 21-74, Latino, Black, white, Asian, mixed; beach, club, bar staff, cooks, workers, office, tourists, police with invented insignia, three gangs in their own colors)

Garment generator: tops, shirts with collars area/plackets/buttons, bomber, vest, hi-vis, blazer, jeans, chinos, cargo, shorts, swimwear, skirts, dresses, aprons, beanies, caps, pumps with heels, sandals
items.evidence: docs/v2/shots/people-look/grp*.webp, face_*.webp, club_poses.webp; known flaws in docs/v2/reports/people-look.md (boxy blazer, no modelled collars, nude pumps read as bare feet, strapless slip dress)

items.name: Fabric detail: seams, topstitching, hems, plackets, pockets, folds baked to normal maps, denim fades/whiskers/honeycombs, prints; runtime knit/rib/weave/twill/pique micro-normals
items.evidence: docs/v2/shots/people-look/grp0.webp (denim fades, stripes), face_bartender_vest_m.webp (shirt placket, buttons, vest)

items.name: Skin: MakeHuman CC0 photo skin repainted per archetype (tone, scalp, fades, beards, make-up), wrap lighting with warm scatter, pore micro-normal, low specular
Hair: matte cards with Kajiya-Kay (two weak lobes), fades as stacked short-hair shells + painted fade, buns, ponytails, braids, afro, bobs, beanies and caps
items.evidence: hair shells and cards visible in face_*.webp; bun reads small; Kajiya-Kay not judged in a dim room

items.name: Animation: procedural gait generator (walk m/f/heels/old/brisk, jog, run, sprint), idles with weight shift, cross arms, lean on wall, phone, talk, drink, photo, 3 dances, bartending, pour, shake, cook, tray, sit, stool; Mixamo clips no longer used by NPCs
items.evidence: docs/v2/shots/people-look/walk34.webp, club_poses.webp, seat_side.webp (sit fix after this shot not re-shot)

items.name: LOD and performance: full mesh to 15 m (budget 8), 7k tris to 60 m, 1.7k tris beyond; shadows within 26 m; animation every 1/2/3 frames by distance; shared per-archetype clips, materials, textures
items.evidence: fps before 16.0 / after 15.5 at load 14-18 (unreliable), see report

items.name: Peds and venues use archetypes (game.npc.createPed), legacy bodies as fallback; API game.npc.spawnPosed({ archetype, pose, pos, rot }) for interiors-art
items.evidence: docs/v2/shots/people-look/club_velvet_undertow_ingame.webp (venue people are archetypes); game.npc.spawnPosed used by the club test
